description: Submit a long video for clipping, either by public link in url (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Vimeo, Zoom, Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, LinkedIn, Facebook, Rumble, Dailymotion, Medal.tv, or a direct https link to a video file; Google Drive and Dropbox links must be shared publicly) or, for a local file, by upload_id after katto_upload_video and the PUT of the file. Pass exactly one of url or upload_id. Consumes 1 video from your monthly quota — check katto_get_usage first. Clips are produced asynchronously; returns a job id, then poll katto_get_job every 30-60 s until status is 'completed', or pass webhook_url to be notified (url jobs only). Pass idempotency_key when you might retry a url job, so a retry never spends a second video (an upload can only be started once anyway). Fails if the URL is unsupported, the uploaded file is missing, or the video is longer than your plan allows.

clipLength.description: Target length band for the clips, in seconds. Guides candidate selection by setting a minimum and maximum duration; it is a preference, not a hard cut. Omit to let the model decide.

customPrompt.description: Free-text hint about what matters in this video. Its keywords nudge selection toward matching moments. It does not filter: a clip that matches nothing can still be selected if it scores well.

topics.description: Comma-separated topics to favour. Merged with customPrompt into a single keyword hint, so both bias the ranking rather than restrict it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique string (max 255 chars). Retrying with the same key returns the original job instead of creating a second one and spending another video. Use one per intended job, e.g. a UUID.

upload_id.description: Instead of url: the upload_id returned by katto_upload_video, once the file has been PUT to its upload_url. Starts clipping that file.

url.description: Public video URL to clip (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Vimeo, Zoom, Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, LinkedIn, Facebook, Rumble, Dailymotion, Medal.tv, or a direct https link to a video file). Pass url OR upload_id.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL that receives a signed POST when the job finishes, so you do not have to poll. Verify the signature with the secret from katto_get_webhook_secret. Private and local addresses are refused.

name: katto_create_clip_job
